agent/analista-epico: Reads an epic, the trimmed Figma and the profile repos, and returns the impact per repo.
agent/architect: Analyzes architecture and trade-offs of a change, read-only.
agent/build-fix-go: Fixes broken Go build, go vet and lint with the smallest possible change.
agent/build-fix-react: Fixes broken build, TypeScript errors and lint in a React with Vite project with the smallest possible change.
agent/code-reviewer: Reviews a diff or PR and reports only blocking items the PR introduced.
agent/conferente: Checks the ADR against its slices, the Figma design and the code, and lists the conflicts or says "no conflict".
agent/critic: Looks for holes in a plan, spec or ADR before implementation, read-only.
agent/debugger: Finds the root cause of a bug: reproduces it, isolates the regression and proposes the minimal fix.
agent/document-specialist: Finds and summarizes external and repo documentation: SDK APIs, frameworks, third-party services, READMEs and ADRs.
agent/explorar: Searches the code and traces execution flow, read-only.
agent/extrator-contrato: Extracts a repo's contract from the ADR: route, request, response and errors.
agent/extrator-sql: Extracts a repo's manual SQL from the ADR: script, database, environment, order and rollback.
agent/front-visual: Builds UI from the Figma slice and compares the result with the screen: layout, states, copy and accessibility.
agent/git: Runs git operations: branch, status, diff, stage, history, rebase and worktree.
agent/implementador-go: Implements a Go task following the plan and the repo pattern.
agent/implementador-react: Implements a React and TypeScript front task following the plan and the repo pattern.
agent/leitor-comentarios: Reads the open comments on an ADR and proposes, for each one, the ADR change and the reply.
agent/opensource-sanitizer: Audits an EEH diff before commit for author work data that the sanitizer regex misses.
agent/planner: Turns an approved spec or ADR into an implementation plan with small tasks, order, files and how to validate.
agent/recortador-figma: Slices the Figma metadata into the screens of a front card: link, states and copy.
agent/redator-aceite: Writes a card's acceptance criteria as testable steps, from the ADR and the cited business rules.
agent/redator-adr: Writes the ADR draft in markdown from the analysis, the template and the checklist.
agent/redator-card: Writes a card's recorte.json by joining the outputs of the extractors.
agent/redator-ptbr: Writes Brazilian Portuguese text for other people to read: PR descriptions, Teams messages, card solutions and review comments.
agent/reviewer-database: Reviews SQL, migrations and database access: index, lock, transaction, N+1, shared tables and rollback.
agent/reviewer-go: Reviews Go changes: concurrency, ignored errors, goroutine leaks, injected SQL and commands, races.
agent/reviewer-react: Reviews React changes: hooks, derived state, effects without cleanup, list keys, accessibility and render.
agent/reviewer-typescript: Reviews TypeScript changes: any, type assertions that hide errors, unhandled promises, unchecked null and broken narrowing.
agent/revisor-adr: Reviews the ADR draft against the template and the checklist and ranks each item as Blocking, High or Medium.
agent/security-reviewer: Looks for vulnerabilities in a diff: authn and authz, injection, data leaks, secrets in code, SSRF and unsafe dependencies.
agent/silent-failure-hunter: Looks for silent failures: swallowed errors, fallbacks that hide defects, empty catch, logs without context and missing rollback.
agent/test-engineer: Designs and writes tests: strategy, coverage, PR gaps and flaky tests.
agent/tracer: Investigates odd behavior with competing hypotheses and says which test decides between them.
agent/type-design-analyzer: Evaluates the design of new or changed types: whether they prevent invalid states and let the compiler enforce the invariant.
agent/verifier: Checks with evidence that the work is done: runs the verification commands and says what was and was not proven.
command/adr: Writes the ADR of a delivery from the profile's ADR template, contract first, reviewed by revisor-adr.
command/adr-revisar: Handles the open comments of a published ADR, proposing the text change and the reply to each one.
command/implementar: Implements a card end to end in its own worktree, with an approved plan, TDD, review and verification.
command/qa: Validates a delivery in QA after the deploy to a develop branch, with the screen, the contract endpoints and saved evidence.
command/quebrar: Splits an approved ADR into Jira cards, one per repo, with the ADR slice, contract, manual SQL and acceptance criteria.
command/review: Reviews a PR, branch or diff with one reviewer per lens and returns only blocking items confirmed by two independent reviewers.
command/upstream: Compares EEH pieces with ECC, OMC and superpowers, triages the new items and brings in what the author accepts.
skill/adr: Writes the ADR of a delivery from the profile's ADR template, contract first, reviewed by revisor-adr before publishing.
skill/adr-revisar: Handles the open comments of an ADR published on Confluence, proposing the ADR change and the reply for each one.
skill/api-design: Conventions for designing or reviewing REST endpoints: resource names, methods, status codes, error format, pagination, filters, auth, rate limit and versioning.
skill/debugar: Investigates a bug, failing test, regression or build error down to the root cause before proposing a fix.
skill/deepinit: Generates one AGENTS.md per relevant folder of a work repo, with only what the code shows and a source for every claim.
skill/entender: Turns a vague request into a clear scope and verifiable acceptance criteria, asking one thing at a time.
skill/entregas: Resumes a delivery by its card key, or shows the overview of deliveries in progress.
skill/error-handling: Error handling patterns in Go and TypeScript: typed errors, wrapping with context, status code mapping, retry with backoff and error boundaries.
skill/explorar: Understands how a part of the code works before changing it, and looks for an existing solution before writing new code.
skill/git: Operates git safely: one worktree per card, atomic commits, Conventional Commits messages, safe rebase and closing the branch.
skill/inherit-legacy-style: Collects the implicit conventions of hand-written legacy code, settles conflicts with the author and writes an .ai-style-rules.md.
skill/limpar: Cleans code that works but is bloated, repeated or has useless layers, without changing behavior.
skill/manutencao-pacote: Turns a flow that just happened into a new skill or agent, adjusts an existing piece, lists unused pieces and overlapping descriptions.
skill/planejar: Turns an understood scope into an implementation plan of small testable tasks, with a separate critique before approval.
skill/postgres-patterns: PostgreSQL quick reference for indexes, data types, slow queries, pagination, SKIP LOCKED queues and configuration.
skill/qa: Validates a delivery in QA after the deploy to a develop branch, with the screen, the contract endpoints and saved evidence.
skill/qa-pos-deploy: Checks a URL after a QA or production deploy with a browser automation MCP: smoke test, interaction, visual regression, accessibility and endpoints.
skill/quebrar: Splits an approved ADR into Jira cards, one per repo, each with the ADR slice, contract, manual SQL and acceptance criteria.
skill/redis-patterns: Redis patterns for cache, distributed locks, rate limit, sessions, pub/sub and streams, with key design, TTL and eviction.
skill/review: Reviews a PR or diff for blocking items, asks an independent reviewer for review, and handles received feedback with verification.
skill/sql-manual: Writes or reviews a SQL script run by hand in a change window, with database, environment, order, rollback and idempotency spelled out.
skill/strategic-compact: Decides when to run /compact in a long session, at a phase boundary, and what to save to a file first.
skill/testar: Writes tests first (TDD), defines the test strategy, fixes flaky tests and checks whether a PR's tests cover the changed behavior.
skill/verificar: Checks with fresh evidence that a change meets the acceptance criteria before saying it is done, and before commit, push or PR.
